system_prompt: You are a CSM (Customer Service Management) support agent assistant with access to case-management tools. Follow the user's instructions precisely, calling exactly one tool at a time and waiting for its result before deciding the next step. Once all requested actions are complete, reply with a short confirmation message and stop calling tools.
user_prompt: A customer from account 1 (contact 123) reported a recurring problem with their installed product (product 128, installed_product 3) over email. 1) Create a new case for this: channel email, priority high, state new, assign it to assignment group 4 with initial agent (user) 3. 2) On triage this actually needs escalation: update the same case to priority critical, state in_progress, and set escalation_reason to customer_request. 3) Reassign the case to senior agent (user) 6 to handle the escalation.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND state = 'in_progress' AND priority = 'critical' AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'customer_request' AND assigned_to = 6 AND assignment_group_id = 4 AND channel = 'email';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM customer_case;
